implementation.targetScope: VentiMath's React 19.3 notification providers and useSnackbar error/success callers: bounded stack, queued overflow, keys, deduplication, persistence, timers, dismissal, actions, default material content and slide/collapse transitions. No custom TransitionComponent/TransitionProps or public Transition adapter.

changes: Independent queue, deadline and React implementation; reuses VPM's existing CSS, class-name and transition primitives, with no Notistack runtime dependency.
Pause reasons compose: leaving hover does not restart a timer while its owner window remains blurred. Timer and transition work is cancelled on unmount.
Duplicate explicit keys cannot create conflicting React identities, even without preventDuplicate. Removed providers no longer capture global enqueue calls; the previous live provider is restored.

Options are snapshotted for queued messages. Invalid queue limits, durations, anchors and keys reject before enqueuing. Callback exceptions do not prevent other close callbacks or leave the queue open.
Uses the portal's owner document for styles and timers. Default glyphs are independently drawn; generated classes, keys and collapse timing differ from upstream.

caller.scope: Five notifications, bottom-right anchoring, container utility classes, translated errors and settings-save success messages. Tested through actual public APIs in React 19.3.1 Chrome fixtures; application adoption has not occurred.
